An omnibus counterterrorism law passed six weeks after September 11. It widened surveillance and information-sharing authorities, expanded anti-money-laundering rules, and broadened terrorism offenses and immigration exclusions.

::: {.official-links}
**Read the law** (official GovInfo text)

[Enacted text: Pub. L. 107-56](https://www.govinfo.gov/link/plaw/107/public/56){.btn-official}
:::

## Key provisions

- Sec. 215: orders for 'any tangible things' relevant to a terrorism or counterintelligence investigation.
- Sec. 218: foreign intelligence need only be 'a significant purpose' of FISA surveillance, lowering the wall between intelligence and criminal investigators.
- Sec. 505: broader use of national security letters.
- Title III: anti-money-laundering measures, including Section 311 special measures against foreign jurisdictions and banks.
- Sec. 805: expanded the definition of material support for terrorism.

## Why it matters

It reshaped [FISA](fisa-1978.qmd) and the material support offenses created by [AEDPA](aedpa-1996.qmd). The bulk telephone metadata program later justified under Section 215 led directly to the [USA FREEDOM Act](usa-freedom-2015.qmd).

## Current status

Most of the act is permanent. Section 215 (business records) and section 206 (roving wiretaps), along with the lone wolf provision, expired on March 15, 2020 and have not been renewed.

[Last checked November 10, 2026.]{.checked}

## Where it sits

- **Layer.** Specific authorization. Laws aimed at a particular conflict, country, program, or problem. Most work through a framework statute: an AUMF through the War Powers Resolution, a sanctions act through IEEPA. ([How the layers work](../study/index.qmd#the-authority-stack))
- **Builds on.** [FISA](fisa-1978.qmd), [IEEPA](ieepa-1977.qmd), [AEDPA (terrorism)](aedpa-1996.qmd).
- **Built upon by.** [USA FREEDOM Act](usa-freedom-2015.qmd).
- **Codified in.** [Title 50 U.S.C.](title50-usc.qmd).
- **Era.** After September 11 ([timeline](../study/timeline.qmd)).
- **Study.** [Unit 7: Surveillance law](../study/units/surveillance.qmd) (core reading).
